research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Freshworks is researching and developing cloud-based solutions for helpdesk automation, focusing on predicting customer churn from multi-product data using sequential deep learning models, processing user queries for virtual agents by identifying user intents, managing connections in multi-tenancy computing environments, extracting key-value information from unstructured data, optimizing lead pooling and ranking with machine learning, and incremental clustering of messages to enhance scalability. These areas reflect advancements in automation and intelligent support systems.
